messages:
tara: starting 22:00 UTC change window. Scope: api v2.1.0, console schema header_split -> string[], runtime quick shim, router compatibility pin. tagging eng-runtime + infra.

deploy-bot: plan: canary @22:05 UTC 5% for 8m -> 25% for 12m -> full. Rollback: `deploy rollback api --to v2.0.9`.

noah: quick compatibility note: console now emits header_split as array; router must flatten or runtime must normalize else KV keys differ. Prefer router pin for short term.

rachel: agreed. We'll pin router to 3.4.2 with `header_passthrough=flatten`. Runtime will enable `HEADER_ARRAY_SHIM=true` only for first canary.

anna: checklist before canary: 1) manifest pins router=3.4.2 2) runtime shim env set 3) alerts: p95>240ms, 5xx>1%, kv_hit_rate<85% 4) release notes draft (sdk@redwood.com contact).

ops-bot: alerts configured. Auto-fallback: if 5xx_rate>2% for 2m -> rollback and pin router.

andeploy: canary started at 22:05:00 UTC (5%). Monitoring enabled.

tara: +5m snapshot: p95=200ms, 5xx=0.1%, kv_hit_rate=91%. Proceed to 25%.

noah: plan a shim flip test at 25% after 20m: toggle HEADER_ARRAY_SHIM=false for 15m and watch kv_hit_rate and p95. If kv_hit_rate drops >7 points rollback shim.

rachel: I'll execute flip and monitor.

deploy-bot: 25% at 22:33:00 UTC.

rachel: flipping shim off at 22:55:10 UTC. Observing.

ops-bot: post-flip 10m: p95=208ms, 5xx=0.12%, kv_hit_rate=87%. Slight dip but within thresholds.

tara: proceed to full rollout in 10m and keep router pinned for 24h. Release notes ready. Good job. :tada:
